images.alt: Minister for Tourism Louise Upston, standing on the trail site with Herenga ā Nuku regional field advisor Amie Pont and Gerard Hyland from Dunedin Tunnels Trails Trust.

post.text: We're proud to have supported the early stages of the Dunedin Tunnels Trail by providing $10,000 to cover the project’s legal costs, enabling it to move forward. With the project now ready to grow, the Minister for Tourism has announced the Government will invest $2 million to extend the trail.
